kashikaEnglish: When a सित् affix follows, what precedes is called pada.
englishShort: In presence of a प्रत्यय having सकार as इत्संज्ञक, the प्रकृति gets the term पद.
englishFull:
Before an affix with indicatory स् (सित्), the preceding word is पद.

This excepts @ref[1.4.18] (which would make it भ).

**Example:** भवत् + छस् (@ref[4.2.115]) → भवदीयः "belonging to you"

The स् in छस् is indicatory, so भवत् is treated as पद, and @ref[7.1.2] applies.
